description: This file contains functions for managing downloads, uploads, and dialogs in a browser automation context using Playwright. It includes utilities for creating download paths, waiting for downloads, handling file uploads, and dialog interactions.

methods.name: buildTempDownloadPath
methods.description: Generates a temporary download path with a UUID and sanitized filename.

methods.name: createPageDownloadWaiter
methods.description: Creates a promise-based waiter for download events with timeout and cancel capabilities.

methods.name: saveDownloadPayload
methods.description: Saves the download payload to a specified path, creating directories as needed.

methods.name: awaitDownloadPayload
methods.description: Waits for a download event and processes the payload, ensuring it is not superseded.

methods.name: armFileUploadViaPlaywright
methods.description: Handles file upload via Playwright, resolving paths and interacting with file chooser.

methods.name: armDialogViaPlaywright
methods.description: Handles dialog acceptance or dismissal via Playwright.

methods.name: waitForDownloadViaPlaywright
methods.description: Waits for a download to complete via Playwright and returns download info.

methods.name: downloadViaPlaywright
methods.description: Initiates a download via Playwright by clicking a reference element and waiting for completion.
